findings.headline: €25,000 in Current account earns €0 a year after DIRT
findings.detail: At 0% it earns €0 a year. The highest instant-access rate Saoi holds (bunq Free) would pay about €520 after DIRT on the same money, with access kept.

findings.headline: Car loan at 9% costs more than any savings account earns
findings.detail: €9,000 at 9% costs about €810 a year in interest. The same money in the highest-paying instant-access account would earn about €187.20 after DIRT. Interest still to pay at the current repayment: €1,274.96. €25,000 is held in savings.

candidateGoals.label: Clear the highest-rate debt
candidateGoals.why: A debt costs more in interest than any savings account earns.

candidateGoals.label: Put idle money to work
candidateGoals.why: Money is held at a rate well below what instant access pays.

assumptions: Savings rates are compared after DIRT at 33%, over twelve months, in instant-access accounts.
Variable rates are assumed to stay as published.
Goal pace counts savings held and monthly saving before interest; every goal is set against all savings held.
attributions: Source: Competition and Consumer Protection Commission, www.ccpc.ie
